mappings.rationale: The work Agent's prompt encodes the full project goal across all phases (amp_conversion, motion_retargeting, amp_training, completed). The agent owns end-to-end execution responsibility; the graph routes phase transitions.

Phase ordering enforced deterministically by commit-success transitions advance_B (A_healthy→motion_retargeting, idx 14), advance_C (B_healthy→amp_training, idx 15), advance_done (C_healthy→completed, idx 16). No transition advances phase without the corresponding health flag true.

All three health flags default false and are only set true by gate-specific transitions (gateA_pass idx 3, gateB_pass idx 5, gateC_pass idx 7). Phase advance transitions check each flag in their when conditions.
Gate pass transitions require all verification flags simultaneously true in deterministic when conditions. The Agent cannot bypass these checks; the prompt forbids lowering thresholds.

Gate A: gateA_pass (idx 3) sets A_healthy; gateA_fail (idx 4) increments stale_countA; gateA_stale_stop (idx 18) sets error=true and routes to commit for final write; stop_error (idx 12) then routes to failed; error_stop (idx 0) catches unrecoverable failures.
Gate B mirrors Gate A: gateB_pass (idx 5)/gateB_fail (idx 6); gateB_stale_stop (idx 19) sets error and routes to commit for final write; error_stop for unrecoverable failures.

Gate C status transitions in commit-success routing: gateC_attention (idx 20, stale_countC>=4→attention_required) and gateC_pivot (idx 21, stale_countC>=2&&normal→pivot_stateC). Priority ensures attention wins over pivot.
Gate C normal: gateC_pass (idx 7) sets C_healthy; gateC_fail (idx 9) increments; gateC_better (idx 11) decrements with min-0 guard (when stale_countC>0).
gateC_pivot_done (idx 8) resets stale_countC=0 and status_C=normal. Work Agent prompt instructs updating directions_tried.json with failure reasons during pivot.
attention_required: gateC_attention (idx 20) sets status, attention_reported (idx 1) forces error after report. stop_error (idx 12) routes to failed terminal.

Writer lane declares exact write modes for all six state files. Commit prompt action 1 writes progress.json with ALL required C11 fields: iteration, phase, phase_status (derived), total_findings (counted), code_revision and dataset_revision (from commit_payload or carried forward).
Writer lane enforces append_only for findings.jsonl/iteration_log.jsonl/work.jsonl/orchestrator.jsonl and atomic_replace for progress.json/directions_tried.json/task_spec.md/evaluation.json.
Phase advance transitions commit phase change; work Agent prompt instructs writing code_revision/dataset_revision in commit_payload; commit prompt carries these into progress.json.

advance_C (idx 15) is the only transition that sets phase to amp_training; its when requires B_healthy==true. task_spec.md uses atomic_replace on writer lane. Work prompt instructs freezing eval protocol on first amp_training entry.
gateA_pass requires gA_contract==true; work prompt instructs generating amp_contract.json; writer lane has atomic_replace on amp_contract.json.
Work Agent prompt mandates ≥5 fixed seeds, mean/std/worst reporting, forbids cherry-picking. gateC_pass requires all four gC_* flags simultaneously true.
Gate C normal-mode transitions are mutually exclusive on outcome and each update stale_countC by at most 1 per activation. The prompt reinforces one-hypothesis-per-experiment.
Counter/status updates exclusively in deterministic transition updates using builtin reducers. Agent outputs semantic outcomes only; thresholds are in graph conditions.
Writer lane exclusively owns all state/ and logs/ writes. Work Agent prompt rule 1 forbids writing state/logs/. All persistence through commit node.
gate_check = deterministic when conditions on gate pass transitions requiring all verification flags. route_by_status = priority-ordered commit-success transitions reading post-update $state.

All terminal paths route through commit first: stop_error (idx 12) and stop_completed (idx 13) are commit→terminal; gateA_stale_stop (idx 18) and gateB_stale_stop (idx 19) now route commit→commit (self-loop with error=true) so commit writes final error state/report, then stop_error catches error==true→failed. attention_reported (idx 1)→commit→stop_error→failed.
Graph limits bound activations (300), wall time (7 days), cost ($600). Gate stale stops (>=10) and Gate C attention/pivot provide task-level bounds. work_failed/commit_failed provide failure exits.
Work Agent prompt specifies bounded retry with account-pool rotation for quota. timerPolicy maxParks=48 bounds polling. Smoke train before long runs instructed.
Work Agent prompt states ~30 min poll intervals via hard park and early termination on plateau. timerPolicy.maxDelayMs=3600000 and maxParks=48 bound total polling.
Work Agent prompt contains full audit checklist. audit_pass (idx 2) only fires when audit_done==false and outcome=='pass'. error_stop catches missing F1 model/reference.

Gate pass transitions require all independent verification flags true simultaneously, preventing any single superficial signal from advancing a phase. Gate C fail/pivot transitions each update stale_countC by exactly 1. The prompt reinforces no treating imports/loads/reward/video alone as completion.
gateA_pass requires gA_smoke, gA_schema, gA_ckpt, gA_contract all true. Writer lane has atomic_replace for amp_contract.json.
gateB_pass requires gB_replay, gB_loader, gB_isolation all true. Work prompt details retargeting verification.
gateC_pass requires gC_walk, gC_eval, gC_sim2sim, gC_export all true. Work prompt specifies ≥60s walking, ≥95% success, ≤5% fall rate, Sim2Sim thresholds, export verification.
Work lane has owned write on gmr_f1/ for GMR clone/adaptation. Work prompt instructs cloning GMR into gmr_f1/. Declared as blocking directory precondition.
Work lane reads data/ (containing reference npz) and has bash tool for gm CLI. Prompt references gm CLI for Gradmotion.

Work prompt instructs recording code revision, config, data hash, seed, command, task ID to commit_payload (code_revision, dataset_revision, log_entry). Commit writes to logs and progress.json. Terminal paths write before stopping.
